globalFindings.claim: On 44,494 surviving original words from 41 writers, page-normalized departure was associated with longer preceding pauses after the recorded controls. Conditional within-session association, not causal attention. Evaluated engine pin 5f3ad0a; this does not validate this page or admit the current engine.

globalFindings.claim: Selected phrases recurred more in the same writer's other-prompt documents than in other writers' documents on those prompts. Aggregate contrast on 769 matched documents from 52 writers; 462 documents lacked the required comparison support. Final text includes typed and model-suggested material. Evaluated engine pin 5f3ad0a; no individual signature, preference or out-of-corpus guarantee.

globalFindings.claim: Both engine habit-identification variants failed their fixed fake-reference bias controls. Positive observed identification is not valid evidence for a habit badge. The engine's connective and punctuation list differs from Sounding Line's PMAP style measure; that measure's observed 47% cannot be transferred here. No ledger row.

A model that starts from everyone and adjusts a little for each writer forecast these writers better than population rates. Saved, exposed forecasts; 16,855 decisions from 61 writers. Writer-resampled 95% interval, conditional on saved fits; no new admission. No ledger row.

In planted tests, these instruments found a writer's constant lean, not yet their taste or habits. Synthetic outcomes on fixed human-record covariates; this is not a limit on all possible readers. No ledger row.

Does a root or function cue improve root recovery beyond leaf evidence? R4 nominates a 0.99-reliable root cue with no observed leaves after two complete burn-ins: root log-loss gain is 0.64312 nats, with a descriptive 95% interval of 0.62467–0.66157. All 90 settings and 184,320 cases pass reconstruction and full replay; the 20 neutral-cue settings remain exact zeros. This is a constructed-method discovery, not confirmation or evidence about people. miniature, architecture untested. Reader: Declared exact readers and frozen rivals; N5 hierarchical rival approximate. Choice model: Supplied finite synthetic observation laws; see source report.

globalFindings.claim: How much does forecasting from the reader’s own policy cost? N5 nominates prior-shift calibration at the largest anchor-shaped bias with no personal records: log-loss gain is 0.94929 nats, with a descriptive 95% interval of 0.90291–0.99567. Both full burn-ins verify all 128 settings and 262,144 cases. This is a constructed-method discovery with supplied population rates; the approximate hierarchical rival is not an exact ceiling, and no human benefit is established. miniature, architecture untested. Reader: Declared exact readers and frozen rivals; N5 hierarchical rival approximate. Choice model: Supplied finite synthetic observation laws; see source report.
